# muvid

> Tools to make music videos

- [muvid.footage.scoring.grid](muvid.footage.scoring.grid.html.md): The song-time score grid: &#96;ScoreTrack&#96;, resample-to-grid, robust normalization,
- [muvid.footage.scoring.lipsync](muvid.footage.scoring.lipsync.html.md): Lip-sync tier (OPT-IN, OFF BY DEFAULT): SyncNet LSE-C vs the master’s Demucs vocal stem.
- [muvid.footage.scoring.motionbeat](muvid.footage.scoring.motionbeat.html.md): Motion-to-beat tier: &#96;motion_beat_bas&#96; + &#96;motion_onset_xcorr&#96; → song-grid tracks.
- [muvid.footage.scoring.orchestrator](muvid.footage.scoring.orchestrator.html.md): The scoring orchestrator: a project (song + aligned clips) → the persisted score tensor.
- [muvid.footage.scoring.quality](muvid.footage.scoring.quality.html.md): Quality tier: sharpness / exposure / stability_shake / face_framing → song-grid tracks.
- [muvid.footage.scoring.segment](muvid.footage.scoring.segment.html.md): Shot boundaries (PySceneDetect) + the per-clip coverage mask.
